caption: The drawing depicts a wooden structure resembling a rectangular frame assembly, constructed primarily from light brown wood with visible grain patterns. The frame consists of two vertical legs on either side and two horizontal beams at the top, creating an open rectangle. In the midsection, there are five vertical metal rods, evenly spaced, cylindrical, and colored grey-silver, each ending in a pointed tip facing downward. At the bottom of the frame, directly under each rod, there are corresponding notches or dips in the lower wood beam, aligned with each rod. Both legs at the base have V-shaped notches cut out. A smaller, unlabeled technical sketch of the frame is present in the lower left corner, showing dimensions and a simple line drawing of the same object. The background is plain and off-white, and the drawing is bordered by a faint rectangular outline. At the bottom right, the text "Vincent A. Rosel Del. 156-1" is written.
title: Candle Mold
